page.layout: One block of running text, full width, with a centred running head above it. No margin notes, no catchword. The gathering signature "C 5" stands at the lower right.

main_text.p: Cauda cometæ aliàs rarior est: quando globus pb materiæ puritatem fortiùs compactus, minùs fumi æquabiliter circumfusi, formâ crinium capitis, emittit: unde Crinitus Cometa. Aliàs densior in modum barbæ, dum globus ardens ob materiæ impuritatem levius compactus multùm fumi emittit: unde Barbatus appellatus est Cometa.

Cometa porrò semper fere apparet sub lacteo circulo: eo maximè tempore, quo aliquis ex tribus planetis superioribus cum alio planeta syno dicè conjunctus, magnam virtutè obtinet ejusmodi materiam viscosam copiosè extrahêdi atqj gubernandi: adjuvante præsertim eclipsi Solis aut Lunæ, vel retrogradatione Mercurii.

Inde nâqj Cometa, ab eo Planeta, à quo præcipuè procreatus est & gubernatur, denominatur ejusqj colorem quodammodo refert: ac crescète per aliarum stellarum irradiationem virtute Planetæ, Cometa quoqj augetur ac crescit, illiusqj motum fere imitatur; decrescente, & ipse sensim decrescit corpore, atqj irregularius movetur. Ita alius cometa est Saturninus, alius Jovialis, alius Martialis.
Alia meteora ignita simpliciain[?] suprema aeris regione, sunt flammæ: vel Continuæ, vel discontinuæ.
Flammæ continuæ sunt, cùm Ignis perpendicularis, & Candela ardens: tum Bolis sive jaculum ardens.

page.notes: The top right corner has a small mark (possibly a printed page mark or a damaged figure) that I could not read, so I have not recorded a page number. The bottom right shows the signature C 5. A faint stamp at the very bottom edge and show-through from the other side are left out. "simpliciain" is a doubtful split of "simplicia in": the printed word is unclear. "pb" in the first paragraph is printed as shown and is probably a printing error for "ob", which the second occurrence in the same paragraph confirms.
